Delivery at Dawn; A young hopeful rushes to the docks in the early morning to welcome a mysterious ship with a precious cargo.

This film was a commisioned by the Nouns community as a celebration and homage to the Etherium Core contributors, The Protocol Guild. We start off in a floating city in the sky where the communities of the Etherium live. Everything is dry and cold until the hero's of our story arrive at dawn bringing new energy that injects life into the their world.

children: Delivery at Dawn is about rediscovering the magic in the mundane

Delivery at Dawn is all about capturing the pure excitement of a child waking up in the morning just to watch the trash collectors do their thing. By creating a world that felt familiar, yet completely new, I tried to capture the childlike awe and wonder of a kid who is genuinely excited to discover how it works. At its heart, I feel like this film is a celebration of the unsung heroes— the bin-men, plumbers, electricians, and all those who work through the night to keep the world running.
